s00-01-story-0eb26e.wav.text: Jesus told a story about a son who threw everything away.

s00-02-pivot-55ecc2.wav.text: But the real surprise in it is the father.

s01-02-story-3a5d46.wav.text: The younger one said, Father, give me my share of the inheritance.

s01-04-talk-9730c7.wav.text: It was like saying, I wish you were already dead.

s01-05-story-94a05a.wav.text: And the father gave it to him.

s01-06-grave-f60663.wav.text: The younger son gathered all he had and took a journey into a far country,

s01-07-grave-ef7285.wav.text: and there he squandered his property in reckless living.

s02-03-story-0fb6a7.wav.text: He got a job feeding pigs, so hungry he wanted to eat their food.

s02-04-story-98d7be.wav.text: And no one gave him anything.

s02-05-grave-1c37b1.wav.text: How many of my father's hired servants have more than enough bread, but I perish here with hunger!

s02-06-story-f10192.wav.text: So he practiced a speech. I'm not worthy to be your son.

s03-01-grave-c0ab1e.wav.text: But while he was still a long way off, his father saw him and felt compassion,

s03-02-grave-e6f29c.wav.text: and ran and embraced him and kissed him.

s03-03-story-0dc46a.wav.text: The son started his speech. But the father wasn't listening.

s03-04-story-6aa62d.wav.text: He was calling for his best robe, a ring, sandals, and a party.

s04-01-grave-455c06.wav.text: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found.

s05-01-pivot-0effae.wav.text: But the older brother was angry, and wouldn't go in.

s05-02-story-fe9577.wav.text: I've worked for you all these years, he said.

s05-03-story-0ad6a1.wav.text: And you never threw me a party.

s05-04-story-177097.wav.text: And the father went out to him too.

s05-05-grave-2340f1.wav.text: Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours.

s06-01-talk-d0aea4.wav.text: Jesus never tells us if the older brother went in.

s06-02-story-0995d3.wav.text: He told this story to religious people, grumbling that he welcomed sinners.

s06-03-pivot-470d33.wav.text: Both sons were a long way off.

s06-04-story-e99d8b.wav.text: And the father went out to both.

s02-06-story-ec44db.wav.text: So he practiced a speech. I'm not worthy to be your son.
